metadata.description: Nine Claude Code mods: undo to any prompt, a usage-limit meter, an agent farm, a context forecast, a destructive-command guard, an edit replay, a files-seen list, a session journal, a code pet, and a clean checklist view.

plugins.name: waypoint
plugins.description: Per-prompt snapshots of your whole project; preview and restore to any earlier prompt, Bash changes included.

plugins.name: limit-meter
plugins.description: Your plan's 5-hour and weekly usage limits above the prompt, with time to reset, used today, and warnings.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A one-line forecast of your context window above the prompt: Clear to Storm, with a sparkline and cost.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds destructive shell commands, shows what they would delete or overwrite, and asks Proceed or Cancel.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Records every edit Claude makes in a turn and lets you step through the diffs with /replay.

plugins.name: files-seen
plugins.description: A live list of every file Claude read or edited this session, in a pane and the status line.

plugins.name: session-journal
plugins.description: Writes a markdown log of every prompt, changed file and command, with a /standup summary.

plugins.name: agent-farm
plugins.description: Your subagents and agent teams as cute farm critters: each works the field with its tool, rests when done, and plays when you hover it.

plugins.name: code-pet
plugins.description: A tiny ASCII pet above your prompt (=^.^=) that cheers when tests pass, worries when commands fail, naps when you're idle, and levels up as you work.

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: Hides tool rows and shows a plain-English checklist above the prompt. Start with /simple on.
